<thought>The isotopic pattern shows a strong monoisotopic peak with successive +1 Da peaks decreasing roughly according to the natural 13C abundance, matching a carbon‑rich molecule (≈16 C atoms). No characteristic Cl, Br, or S patterns are present, and other elements have isotopic contributions too small to be seen. Therefore, carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified from the observed distribution.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
